steps.do: Make a new key, save it in your Passwords app first, then put it in Vercel.
Put the key from your Passwords app in this project's cloud environment. If there is no edit button, delete the old entry and add it again.
Put the same key in the GitHub secret the board-pull Action uses to recover a sealed menu.
Paste the token into the council repo's GitHub secrets.

note: Recorded by board/pull.py. needs_work lists what a session still has to act on.
